turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do singers really need to warm up? I just sing in the car.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For casual car singing, not much. But before a rehearsal or a gig, warming up protects your voice and makes high notes easier.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Unrelated, but My gym membership is up for renewal and there's also a cheaper climbing gym nearby.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Both are good options. Do you want to stick with what you know, or try something new that might keep you more motivated?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm taking twenty-three seconds to decide. Ask me again when they're up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, okay, I know what I'm doing.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: So, have you decided? Renew the gym or switch to climbing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll try climbing. I'm bored of the treadmill.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sounds fun. Most climbing gyms do an intro session, so book that first and see how you like it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Gentle humming, lip trills, which are like blowing a raspberry while you sing, and slides from low to high.
